{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Oatmeal recipes|Oatmeal]]

Oatmeal and red lentils cooked in chicken broth with Sriracha. This can be made with only oats, but red lentils add flavor. 

==Ingredients==
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] red [[Cookbook:Lentil|lentils]]
*¾ cup rolled [[Cookbook:Oats|oats]]
*[[Cookbook:Chicken|Chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
*Up to 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
*Up to ¾ tbsp [[Cookbook:Sriracha|Sriracha]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]

==Procedure==
#Cook the lentils in water until they are very soft.
#If there is any remaining water, [[Cookbook:Straining|strain]] the lentils.
#Mash the lentils.
#In a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], heat the chicken broth.
#Return lentils to the heat and add heated chicken broth and oats.
#When oats are cooked, add Sriracha. The amount of Sriracha depends entirely on your preference.
#Add around ½ tbsp honey and enough salt to season.
